note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried. The English Rooted keeps the BSB on purpose; this Amharic edition quotes the Amharic Bible, as Rooted 2, 3 and 5 do.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' (Phil 4:6 on day 8, Josh 1:9 on day 4, 1 Sam 17:45 on day 5, Eph 6:18, Rom 1:16). OWB's inner quotation marks become ‹› inside the book's «» (2 Cor 12:9), and a closing » that ends a speaker's whole speech is dropped (Gen 39:9, Dan 3:17-18, Josh 1:9). Unmarked recitations are quotations too: the Psalm 23 list on day 3 and the Romans 8:38-39 list on day 29 now give OWB's pieces. 1 Cor 10:13 (day 13) and Dan 1:8 (day 16) were missed by the first inventory and are re-quoted too.

Where the author's next words lean on a quoted word, the prose follows OWB: the wise builder is አስተዋይ (Matt 7:24; intro, day 1, conclusion); 'when I am afraid' is ፍርሃት በሚይዘኝ ቀን (Ps 56:3, and the 'if/when' contrast on day 2); Ps 23's valley is OWB's ድቅድቅ ጨለማ በዋጠው ሸለቆ (no 'shadow of death'); 'be strong and courageous' is ጠንክር፤ ደፋር ሁን and 'discouraged' is ልብህም አይዛል (Josh 1:9); 'Jesus wept' is ኢየሱስ አነባ, two words, as the English says (day 9 title follows); 'He cares' is ግድ ይለዋል (1 Pet 5:7); 'God is faithful' is ታማኝ (1 Cor 10:13); 'resist' is ተቋቋሙ (Jas 4:7; day 17 title and step 2 follow); 'mercies' is ርኅራኄ (Lam 3:22-23); the belt of truth is ቀበቶ, OWB's word, so day 20's መታጠቂያ became ቀበቶ (title included), matching the day-19 list; the devil's 'schemes' are የተንኮል ዕቅዶች and the flaming arrows የእሳት ፍላጻዎች (Eph 6); 'renew their strength' is አዲስ ብርታት (Isa 40:31); Paul's thorn is በሥጋ እሾህ (2 Cor 12:7); 'firm and secure' is የማይናወጥና የጸና (Heb 6:19).

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, retellings and paraphrases in the author's own sentences, the prayers, the author's mock sayings, and two sayings re-personed for the reader to repeat (Lam 3:23, Isa 55:9), which keep OWB's words. The parents' note still says the quotations come from 'the Amharic Bible', as Rooted 5's does.
